substantive_mathematical_review.interface: Same stored C -> same D/s -> one actual compile plan -> saved words
substantive_mathematical_review.finding: Accepted for pinned finite fixture. Independent normal-producer regeneration reproduces all six file hashes, including producer QR packet and observed 7 QR/3 completion/57 atan2 calls. Generator forwards unchanged calls, passes the returned D object to compile_mps once, and verifies C/D unchanged. Compiler's second canonicalization/completion/atan2 is NOT assumed exact; actual saved action is checked directly against literal D.

substantive_mathematical_review.interface: Finite Taylor supplier and outward intervals
substantive_mathematical_review.finding: Recurrence computes x^i/i! and updates once more after degree m; radius is exactly |x|^(m+1)/(m+1)!. Sine/cosine coefficient cycles are correct for either sign of x. Lagrange remainder uses bounded real derivatives. Fraction min/max products contain all four corners; interval addition/negation are sound; floor/ceil on the dyadic grid enlarge endpoints. Mathematical supplier does not certify Python loop/parser/rounding refinement.

Local bond bits occupy 0..a-1 and fresh data bit is a. CX left-action rows use involutive target flip conditional on unchanged control. RY left-action row pairs use [[cos,-sin],[sin,cos]] in saved chronological order. Rows/columns include all 2B basis labels. Independent 90-digit full-primitive matrix products use generic matrix multiplication and a distinct factorial/power Taylor sum; numerical support only.

For d=2B square matrices with maximum entry deviation delta, Frobenius norm <=d*delta and operator norm <=Frobenius norm. Nominal exact-real RY/CX stages are unitary, so each surrogate has norm <=1+eta; surrogates need not be unitary. Embedding on disjoint fresh-data/bond tensor factors preserves operator norms. Telescope gives product(1+eta)-1; an unqualified sum eta would omit growth cross terms. This mathematical reasoning is not a mechanized saved-file refinement.

K_i[in,bit,out]=Uhat_i[bit*B+out,in] selects the fresh input data bit zero, with initial bond zero and full B subsequent bonds. Since later stages cannot retouch emitted data, contracting these cores equals chronological sequential action. Terminal routing emits all bond labels MSB-first with bonds B,B/2,...,1; a=0 is empty. Word order is data n-1..0 then bond a-1..0, mapped to physical j+2^n*b. No padded sector is projected away.

substantive_mathematical_review.interface: Literal target and three-pass exact residual
substantive_mathematical_review.finding: D cores are interpreted as exact dyadic rationals from their actual float64 values and appended zero ancillas. No new normalization, phase alignment, probability-only comparison, or postselection. Reversed local two-product crossGram computes full word dot products; q=Gq+Gd-2cross is the exact nonnegative squared signed difference. Directed integer sqrt yields r^2>=q and handles zero/ties. Exact independent full-word sums confirm q for the actual 32 coordinates and unequal-bond signed test chains.

Independent explicit word sums verify stored raw Gram, D Gram, cross, positive literal ScaledNorm, QR residual squared, and tau=|Gram(C)/s^2-1|. Positivity gives |norm(C)/s-1|<=tau, so QR r+tau bounds D versus normalized stored C. Adding saved sigma+r uses the same D. It does not reach the ideal Hermite target without a source-to-C error and norm floor.

All six missing-artifact cases reject. Existing 15-test suite also rejects unbound file changes, malformed or extra instructions, bad spans, cross-stage/reused wires. Fresh fully rebound on-disk semantic mutations pass schema but produce large changed residuals, correctly distinguishing valid manifests from accurate circuits. Hash inventories and producer booleans are not cryptographic producer authentication; actual independent fixture regeneration supplies finite provenance evidence, not arbitrary-input authenticity.

cost_and_shared_blind_spot_findings.finding: Field counts, pre-GCD operand bounds, decoded values, stage iteration, contraction and directed sqrt are useful finite schedule evidence. They are not total Python integer/BLAS runtime. Fraction GCD, allocation, hashing/JSON/text conversion and all comparison/negation work have no complete runtime trace; source evaluation and compilation costs remain separate.

row_permutation_cell_copies records d^2 logically permuted matrix cells; Python actually creates a list of d row references while sharing row objects. Treat it as conservative logical schedule work, not a literal low-level copy trace.

peak_local_matrix_entries=64 counts one local matrix's cells, not peak total live memory. Endpoint Fractions, current old/new rows, Taylor cache, retained centers and action/target chains coexist. No full-memory or finite-bit complexity certificate follows from this field.

New n=1/n=2 fixtures can have ~1e-16 exact-decimal candidate bounds while Qiskit float replay error is larger. The binary64 parser plus simulation rounding is a different approximate diagnostic; this mismatch is not a counterexample to the exact-rational candidate. Never use machine replay as a certified exact upper-bound oracle.
